mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL YoY and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances, or if the correlation between UNRATE changes and 5-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the correlation between RSAFS changes and 60-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises > 1% in 1 month does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the correlation between INDPRO changes and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected cut in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS cut > 0.25% does not lead to positive 5-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS changes and 5-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a tight labor market and strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increase > 200,000 does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the joint effect of UNRATE and PAYEMS on 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If a sustained increase in HOUST does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the correlation between HOUST changes and 60-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is rising and real GDP (GDPC1) is expanding, it signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rising and GDPC1 expanding does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the joint effect of INDPRO and GDPC1 on 60-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
